title: Nikki C NDE 811
content: I was in a serious, car accident with multiple injuries. I had emergency surgery, as I had a severe break to my right femur. I remember talking with others before my surgery, yet that was the last thing I remember for the following four days. During surgery, I had a pulmonary embolism, which caused respiratory arrest. While I was not conscious during these four days, when I saw my family standing around my bed talking about my condition, I turned to the other side of the bed and stepped out of my body. I began to walk around the room trying to talk to my living family members, but they could not hear me. I then turned and in the other corner of the hospital room was my deceased grandmother and cousin. They were in a light much like sunset. They did not speak at all, yet their level of sure peace was like none I had ever known - before or after. They were smiling, but said nothing as I tried to tell them I was ok - and why wouldn't my living family who were standing there talk to me? I did see myself in the bed unconscious while I was walking around the room.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Clinical death Car crash - respiratory arrest during surgery on femur/broken/rod replacement.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes Confusion, anger toward my living family for not listening to me. Yet, I felt peace with my deceased grandma there.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Yes, two weeks before this happened I had a vivid, frightening dream. I saw a beautiful blue glass-like building with my grandma who is deceased. I then saw myself sitting in a wheelchair in my home and woke up.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I feel my deceased family's spirits came to greet me should I have chosen to go. I am firm in my belief that I had a choice. I do not wish to die, although I now have no fear.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Life is short, live well!!!
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes It was hard to covey to others the level of peace I felt, during my experience.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The unbelievable sense of peace was phenomenal!
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Some believe, some don't. I have no need to explain I know where I was.
